sections.text: Forty male Sprague-Dawley rats weighing 250-300 g were used. THC was provided by the Example Research Supply Company, stored at -20 °C and protected from light. THC was dissolved in ethanol, cremophor and saline. Rats received THC at 5-20 mg/kg intraperitoneally once daily for 14 days. The vehicle group (n = 8) and the high-dose group (n = 8) were compared.
